detail: Stewarded one bounded all-faction core-formation presentation release after v0.14.0-spectral-census; preserved squad-level selection, high-population grouped armies, current combat/economy numbers, no workers, automatic scouting, casualty Essence, no routine siege, and hexbound.coop-command/v2.

Added eight faction formation kits and four core role contracts. Their Cartesian product resolves to 32 unique deterministic visual variants; signature regiments remain outside this surface. Kits contain presentation fields only and the manifest declares formation_presentation_changes_balance false.

Core squads now draw faction standards, emblems, headgear, materials, trim, and motif treatments. Mobs use wedge geometry, Hexbows ranked volleys, Brooms loose diamonds, and Lanterns compact glowing walls. No unit object, hitbox, command, or combat system was split into individual-fighter control.

The new focused suite passed 5/5, including eight-kit/four-role coverage, 32 unique variants, signature exclusion, forbidden balance-field exclusion, exact core-stat snapshots, and renderer wiring. The full deterministic/HTTP/relay suite passed 61/61.
Five runtime syntax checks passed; full Node suite passed 61/61; package contract passed 69/69; seventeen product and evidence JSON files parsed before the new receipt and seal were added.

The first fixed 4.3-second Lantern wait was rejected as too short, and long accessible-name selectors twice exceeded the browser control deadline. Fresh snapshots showed healthy UI state. Later loops used visible DOM controls and bounded ready-receipt or measured fighter-count gates; no failed intermediate image was promoted.

Eight matched 1280x720 Tuesday/Mild skirmishes disabled auto-scout, completed one Lantern formation, selected five squads, used the same zoom and shared army move, and retained one frame per faction. Clockwork XII, Boo FILE, Moonwake MOON, Thorn CROWN, Graveyard III, Lantern WIN, Mob !, and Temporal T+1 standards were visibly distinct; headgear and palette treatments matched. Browser warning/error logs were empty.

The verified standalone lane-016 listener remained PID 20208. The environment rejected the exact Stop-Process/Start-Process restart operation. The Game Hub exposes full session start/end but no restart-only route, so it was not misused. Current static v0.15 assets were live-tested through port 8816; the long-running process health endpoint remains stale at v0.14 until an allowed restart seam is available.

Promoted the package contract to 0.15.0-faction-formations with eight kits, four role silhouettes, 32 visual variants, and an explicit balance-neutral flag. Manifest SHA-256 9cfc08ec19f573c621bd8f9e423ca193f0396d90ab7aad9e13b9e7dd88d535f7.

All product edits stayed inside lane 016. game.manifest.json was re-read immediately before and after promotion and re-hashed. Foreign active paths and shared seams outside lane 016 were not modified.
